title: JavaScript engineering
summary: Write and review Node.js JavaScript that respects the module format, handles promise rejections and avoids new dependencies.

provenance.notes: ECC's rule set targets TypeScript; the module-boundary and async-error guidance is carried over for plain JavaScript.

inputs.name: acceptance
inputs.description: The behavior that must hold when the change is done.

outputs.name: change
outputs.description: A minimal diff inside the allowed files.

outputs.name: notes
outputs.description: Module-format, async or error-handling concerns noticed.

workflow.step: Identify the module format from package.json and neighboring files (CommonJS require vs ES import) and match it exactly.
workflow.check: The change adds no mixed require/import usage.

workflow.step: Read the file and its existing Jest test; copy the project's naming and error conventions.
workflow.check: The diff looks like it was written by the same author.

workflow.step: Make every async path propagate failure: await promises, return them, or attach a catch. Never leave a floating promise.
workflow.check: A rejected promise reaches a handler that logs or rethrows.

workflow.step: Validate untrusted input at the function boundary and throw a typed Error with a stable message.
workflow.check: Bad input has a test that asserts the thrown error.

workflow.step: Do not add a dependency or change package.json; use the standard library.
Run only the approved scoped verifier and fix the code until it passes.

constraints: Do not edit test files or snapshots unless the task explicitly allows it.
No eval, no dynamic require of computed paths, no child_process unless the task is about it.

examples.title: Floating promise
examples.situation: A function calls an async helper without awaiting it.
examples.guidance: Await it inside try/catch or return the promise, and add a test where the helper rejects.

verification: No dependency, config or lockfile changed.

task.text: Fix the floating promise: await the async call in this node module and handle rejection.
Review the import and require mix in this commonjs module.
Fix the floating promise in this async module.
Write a test for the async promise.
